post.description: Browse a dealer's public inventory. Pass dealer_id from search_dealers/nearby_dealers plus the dealer's coordinates; omit dealer_id to list inventory around the coordinates instead. Page with next_offset.

condition.description:
new = new vehicles (getInventory); cpo = certified pre-owned (getCpoInventory).

Provider reference: allowed values ["new", "cpo"]; default "new".

dealer_id.description: Restrict to one dealer (case-insensitive code such as NNA5110). Omit for every dealer the source matches around the coordinates.

include_filters.description: Also return the source's facet lists (option labels, grades, colours, ...) for this result set. Off by default: the new-vehicle facet list runs to hundreds of values.

limit.description:
limit

Provider reference: minimum 1; maximum 50; default 10.

offset.description:
Pass next_offset from the previous page.

Provider reference: minimum 0; maximum 10000; default 0.

postal_code.description: Shopper ZIP code the source uses for regional pricing; optional. Pattern: ^[0-9]{5}$.

post.description: You already have coordinates and want the locator's own record (including hours) in one call. The source caps a call at 100 dealers; there is no paging.

limit.description:
Maximum dealers to return (source cap 100).

Provider reference: minimum 1; maximum 100; default 25.

radius_miles.description:
Radius in miles (the site offers 25, 50, 100, 250, 500); sent to the source in km and enforced on the returned distances.

Provider reference: minimum 1; maximum 500; default 50.

service_ids.description: Keep only dealers whose services include every listed source code, e.g. us_en_nissan_S_CPO.

location.description: US ZIP code (5 digits) or 'City, ST'. Mutually exclusive with latitude/longitude.

offset.description:
Zero-based start index; pass next_offset from the previous page.

radius_miles.description:
Search radius in miles (the site offers 25, 50, 100, 250, 500). Omit for the source default.

Provider reference: minimum 1; maximum 500.

service_id.description: Keep only dealers offering this source service code, e.g. us_en_nissan_S_CPO. Pattern: ^[A-Za-z0-9_]+$.
